description.value: The Sauce Pasta Cafe is a casual gourmet pasta spot in Vancouver's West End, built around a rotating lineup of more than a dozen housemade Italian sauces prepared fresh daily from local ingredients. It pitches itself as high-end Italian food without the tablecloths or reservations, available as takeout, delivery, or casual dine-in. For a touring cyclist in the West End, it offers a quick, filling, customizable pasta meal close to Stanley Park.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (12 spaces, covered) at 26m; stands (6 spaces) at 64m; stands (3 spaces, covered) at 92m; stands (3 spaces, covered) at 92m; stands (4 spaces) at 97m. Total: 28 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business is open at 861 Denman Street, Vancouver, BC V6G 2L9, with phone +1 (604)-681-7180 corroborating the OSM address (OSM had no phone). Takeout is confirmed by both OSM tag takeaway=yes and the website's prominent 'Pasta To-Go!' / 'Italian Take Out & Delivery' framing, with Uber Eats and DoorDash also listed. Gluten-free penne (+$3) is explicitly on the menu and numerous sauces are vegetarian (Marinara, Alfredo, Pesto, Creamy Mushroom, Rose, etc.); no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi anywhere on the site.
